factsAccepted: Growth decelerating (15% YoY current vs. 25% growth two years ago) while margins compressing (15% EBITDA vs. 18%). Revenue per recruiter declining 12% (from $340k to $300k) in two years, suggesting either recruiter productivity falling or bench time increasing. Salary costs rising 18% in 18 months, outpacing revenue growth.

Utilization declining from 82% to 78%, suggesting increased bench time. Recruiter turnover rising to 20% annually (from 12% two years ago), indicating talent retention challenge. Productivity decline could be due to recruiter churn (less experienced team), market conditions (harder to place), or client demand softening.

Tech hiring (45% of revenue) growing 18% YoY (healthy), but fintech (40% of revenue) growing only 8% (slower), reflecting macro sensitivity. Executive search premium segment, but junior-mid placement (65% of core) more competitive. Competitive pressure from tech companies hiring directly and larger recruiting firms consolidating.
